canada.summary: The Saskatoon police officer who was stuck by a vehicle on Wednesday afternoon is still undergoing treatment in hospital, but is now stable, SPS Chief Cameron McBride said.

lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
The federal government has served Stellantis with a notice of default on its funding agreement after the automaker signed a deal to sell an assembly plant to Roshel, The Canadian Press reports.

A widespread outage hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Thursday, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant’s suite of apps, The Associated Press reports.
Nvidia sell-off continues after CEO Jensen Huang steps down, The Associated Press reports.
Hegseth awards medal to soldier who reprimanded him at Arlington National Cemetery, NBC News reports.
Two construction workers and two children were killed when a residential building fell into an adjacent construction site on Wednesday, BBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
